title: console-observability-triage-scratchpad-owen-park
body:
Console / Observability triage - scratchpad (Owen)

Date: 2026-03-03
Context: personal triage notes for today - follow-ups from customer-reported dashboard anomalies + a couple of internal bug reports. Quick capture so I don't forget threads.

Top priorities
- P1: Investigate INC-1423 (customer: StreamlineAI) - dashboard panels showing 0 QPS for a few models despite traffic. Suspect metric ingestion or routing to metrics cluster.
- P2: Repro of OBS-879 (console graph rendering error in Firefox) - intermittent; may be front-end + data shape combo.
- P3: Follow up on PR #234 (auto-refresh regression) - need to confirm rollout and canary results.

Open tickets / brief status
- JIRA-INC-1423 (StreamlineAI): assigned to Jordan. Customer reported 2026-03-02 18:12 PST. Last seen: panels 0 tokens/sec from 18:10-18:27. Logs show normal request throughput to inference, but metrics pipeline shows drop.
  - Notes: check metrics-ingest logs around 18:05-18:30, particularly kube pod restarts for metrics-collector-east-1b.
  - Quick check performed: queried metrics backend (promql) - no series for model=redwood-mini between 18:08-18:28.
  - Next: ask infra to pull collector logs (ticket INFRA-604), escalate if pods evicted.

- JIRA-OBS-879: console graph rendering error (Firefox 122 on macOS). Repro steps in ticket. Frontend stacktrace points to chart-smoosher.js v1.4.2.
  - Hypothesis: charting lib fails when series have NaN + very short time range (range < 30s).
  - Local repro: tried in Chrome - works; Firefox fails when filter set to "last 1m" and series condensed.
  - TODO: add guard in transform to drop NaN series before scatter -> patch branch obs/guard-nan ready for review.

- GH PR #234: auto-refresh regression after 2026-02-25 deploy. Canary showed some users experienced duplicate requests when refresh triggers while route change occurs. Patch includes debounce logic.
  - Need confirmation from Release Eng that canary reached 5% and no customer-facing metrics regressed. If green, schedule rollback window or safe rollout.

Investigation notes / commands run
- Prometheus query used: sum(rate(console_requests_total{env="prod",route=~"/models/.*"}[1m])) by (route) -> used to validate traffic.
- Checked metrics ingestion pods: kubectl -n metrics get pods -o wide | grep collector-east-1b -> pod metrics-collector-5c8b restarted at 18:06 (OOMKilled)
- Collector logs snippet (tail): "ERROR: failed to push batch to TSDB: timeout" repeated -> suggests transient write pressure.
- Suggestion: check disk pressure on metrics nodes, and verify bulk write retries are in place (collector config).

Quick wins / short-term mitigations
- Add dashboard note for StreamlineAI's workspace: "Investigating - some panels may show 0 QPS due to metrics ingestion blips. Check incident postmortem." (Jordan to add)
- For OBS-879, revert chart-smoosher to v1.4.1 in Firefox build if patch review delayed. Low risk fallback.
- For auto-refresh PR, add server-side idempotency key to avoid duplicated processing while rolling debounce fix.

Follow-ups & owners
- Jordan: obtain collector logs and node metrics (INFRA-604). Add preliminary findings to INC-1423. Due: today EOD 2026-03-03.
- Maya: review PR obs/guard-nan and push for quick patch if tests pass. Ping me for a quick review.
- Aisha: coordinate with Release Eng to verify canary metrics for PR #234 and approve/hold rollout.
- Me (Owen): draft incident note skeleton for INC-1423 and link to postmortem template. Also add dashboard workarounds.

Notes to self / things to remember
- Check whether metrics-collector has been upgraded in last deploy (relnotes 2026-02-24). If so, correlate with regression windows.
- Add small synthetic test that writes a short-burst series and validates end-to-end display on console to catch similar spikes. Could be a CI job that runs every 6 hours.
- Customer comms: confirm we acknowledged StreamlineAI's ticket and asked for any diag screenshots and times. If not, send status update with ETA.

Open questions / unknowns
- Did retention policy change cause compactions that slowed writes around 18:05? (query: check compactor logs / cluster retention jobs)
- Is this limited to east-1b region or cross-region? Metrics cardinality could be different per region.

Meeting notes (triage sync 2026-03-03 10:30)
- Action items: Jordan -> logs, Maya -> frontend patch, Owen -> postmortem template, Aisha -> release coordination.
- Internal priority: keep StreamlineAI panel availability high; if we need to redirect gfx traffic to alternate metric cluster as mitigation, coordinate w/ infra.

Small checklist (for today's triage)
- [x] Triage morning queue
- [ ] Confirm collector pod logs (Jordan)
- [ ] Push frontend guard-nan patch if tests green (Maya)
- [ ] Verify canary metrics for PR #234 (Aisha)
- [ ] Draft incident note & initial customer update (Owen)

References / links 
- INC-1423: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/JIRA-INC-1423
- OBS-879: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/JIRA-OBS-879
- Postmortem template: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Incident+Postmortem+Template
- Slack thread: #obs-triage (see pinned messages 2026-03-02)

End of scratchpad for now. Will update as Jordan/Aisha/Maya report back.
